v1.0:
- First release.
- Portrait button grid: power and mute, play/pause, volume down and up,
  previous and next track, flat EQ, and the six inputs — USB, Bluetooth, HDMI,
  AUX, RCA, OPT.
- One press sends one command; holding a button does not repeat.
- Tested on an Onkyo GX-30ARC. Onkyo command bytes are model-specific, so other
  Onkyo products may not respond to these codes.
